name: Banana Orange Smoothie - Classic 1g PLUS Vape Device - BREEZE Canna
description: Dive into the ultimate smoothie experience with this creamy blend of ripe bananas and zesty oranges. Enhanced with beta caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpenes, this deliciously crafted blend brings together the perfect balance of tropical sweetness and citrus zing for an uplifting and creative experience that's as satisfying as your favorite breakfast smoothie.
